notes: Second dispatch, from commit 9fe732b. The first build (commit 898b046) completed, but its smoke test showed onnxruntime listing the MIGraphX provider and then falling back to the CPU because the Python wheel lacks libonnxruntime_providers_migraphx.so; 9fe732b links the native library into the wheel. Verified on 2026-09-27 with the rebuilt Python package: as the frigate user, run from a readable working directory, the model compiles through MIGraphX in 86 s and infers at a median of 7.3 ms against 17 ms on the CPU. Earlier smoke runs segfaulted inside comgr only because they were launched from /home/bdhill, which the frigate user cannot stat; the service runs from / so it is unaffected. Activation is a separate, operator-approved step: make test-ser8 restarts Frigate on the GPU without changing the boot default.
